regions.text:
B
( 28 )
LJ/806
111. The cost of depreciation generation funds is equal to
(1) Cost of equity (2) Cost of debt (3) Overall cost of capital (4) Cost of retained earnings
112. The interest rate that equates the present value of the expected future cash flows to the initial cost outlay is
(1) ARR (2) NPV (3) IRR (4) Payback
113. The most important variable while calculating the cost of debt is
(1) Earnings (2) Dividends (3) Investment (4) Tax rate
114. Which one of the following will take place when a fair return is not realized as capitalization ?
(1) Under capitalization (2) Moderate capitalization (3) Over capitalization (4) No capitalization
115. The ratio that indicates a firm's commitment to meet short-term liabilities is called
(1) Proprietory ratio (2) Turnover ratio (3) ROI (4) Current ratio
116. Sales value variance is the difference between
(1) Standard sales and Actual sales (2) Budgeted sales and Actual sales (3) Standard sales and Budgeted sales (4) Industry sales and Firm's sales
117. When margin of safety is 20 percent and P/V ratio is 60 percent, the profit will be
(1) 30 percent (2) 33 \frac{1}{3} percent (3) 12 percent (4) 16 percent
118. The difference between fixed and variable cost has a special significance in the preparation of
(1) Master budget (2) Flexible budget (3) Cash budget (4) Functional budget
119. The time normally taken in replenishing inventory after the order has been placed is
(1) Gestation time (2) Operating time (3) Lead time (4) Replenishing time
120. Market risk is measured by
(1) Beta co-efficient (2) EBIT (3) Degree of leverage (4) Degree of freedom
